args.root_cause:
TownCore's plugins/TownCore/config.yml had shop.tax-rate set to the string "5%" (file mtime 06:13:37). TownCore validates tax-rate as a number between 0 and 1, failed validation at its tick (TownCore.java:55) at 06:13:38, logged an error and disabled itself. Shop/town features were offline while the other plugins and the server kept running.</root_cause>
<parameter name="actions">Checked status and logs; MSPT spike at startup settled. Found TownCore ERROR at 06:13:38 showing shop.tax-rate "5%" failed validation and the plugin disabled itself. Declared incident. Read plugins/TownCore/config.yml. Changed shop.tax-rate from "5%" to 0.05 (same rate, numeric form), leaving other keys unchanged. Tried 'pl enable TownCore' from the console; it did not re-enable the plugin. Broadcast a warning to players, waited 10 s, then restarted the server (players were disconnected briefly and reconnected). After restart TownCore enabled cleanly; verified over ~80 s: TPS ~20, MSPT ~2, both players online, no new errors.</actions>
<parameter name="resolved">true
args.residual_risk: The config was edited by someone at 06:13:37 and I converted "5%" to 0.05 on the assumption that 5% was the intended rate; the editor should confirm. Future edits to tax-rate in percent form will break TownCore again without a validator-friendly format. The restart disconnected Steve_Mines and Alex_Builds briefly. The earlier MSPT spike at startup (68 ticks behind) was not investigated further and had cleared by the time I checked.
